name: Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited
summary: Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the food, healthcare, property, restricted B-BBEE, and enterprise development businesses in South Africa, Australia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Food and Investments. The company offers food products, such as wild-caught fish, shellfish, traded, dairy, and convenience foods. It also operates in retail clothing; distributes healthcare products; holds treasury shares; and owns property. Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa.
